title: Chapter 6990: Take You In

Chapter 6990: Take You In

Chapter 6990: Take You In

Eventually, the group made it through Omen Path. Although Till Ancestor’s words and even expression were harsh, he never abandoned the duo.

His protection of Li Qiye was especially precious since they were strangers. Moreover, Li Qiye was only a mortal, nothing more than an ant in cultivators’ eyes. He kept his word regardless of the dangerous situations.

Mo Xiangsheng was even more protective of Li Qiye, keeping an eye on him at all times. He didn’t want to lose a potential disciple.

The next area was a pitch-black lake.

“Dusk Realm soon.” Till Ancestor said before tossing something into the lake.

It soared in the air and transformed into a plot of land with a house containing all the essentials. Till Ancestor entered the house without saying anything.

“We’re going in too.” Mo Xiangsheng brought Li Qiye up there.

Once they boarded, Till Ancestor activated a secret art, causing the plot to spin.

“Rumble!” It formed a maelstrom on the lake as it descended without being engulfed.

Mo Xiangsheng wasn’t worried at all and prepared his best tea: “Senior, we have troubled you along the way. Although this tea is too crude for someone of your stature, please try it.”

Amidst Till Ancestor’s unfriendly stare, he shamelessly kneeled while presenting the tea with both hands: “Please.”

Till Ancestor gave him face and accepted the tea.

“Come, brat, your chance is here. Meeting an immortal is the greatest fortune in your life, offer your elder a cup of tea.” Mo Xiangsheng then told Li Qiye.

“Elder?” Till Ancestor remarked.

“Senior, he will be my disciple, so since you’re my elder, you’re his elder as well.” He explained.

“Scram.” Till Ancestor found his shamelessness boundless.

He prepared a cup of tea for Li Qiye and said: “Brat, offer the elder your respect, perhaps he will grant you a fortune benefiting you a lifetime.”

“It is of no use to me.” Li Qiye smiled and shook his head, surprising Till Ancestor.

Although he protected the mortal along the way, he didn’t pay attention to him. However, the mortal certainly witnessed his incredible powers and abilities.

This was a chance to climb up his branch, perhaps entering a smooth path for cultivation. Thus, the refusal piqued his curiosity.

“I’ve been praising you all this time, don’t be a fool now. Even if you don’t care about becoming an immortal, a bestowed fortune, such as a treasure, will let you live a great life.” Mo Xiangsheng glared at him.

“I like the way I am now.” Li Qiye said.

“You truly don’t want to join an immortal’s branch?” Till Ancestor couldn’t help but ask.

“Senior, don’t try to steal my disciple, or rather, why not take me in instead?” Mo Xiangsheng protested.

“Scram.” Till Ancestor was only interested in Li Qiye: “Do you want to be my disciple?”

This mortal was not special at all. Alas, he felt like making an exception today. Some immortals were whimsical and unpredictable.

“No.” Li Qiye refused.

“Do you know how many wish to join my banner?” His expression darkened.

“That’s your business, not mine.” Li Qiye smiled.

“You!” The mortal angered him.

“Rotten wood, rotten wood.” Mo Xiangsheng wanted to kick Li Qiye away so he could kneel and worship Till Ancestor.

“Senior, I’ll kneel, take me in.” He said.

“Stand aside.” Till Ancestor only found the mortal amusing.

“You’re being unfair, Senior. Am I not exceptional, a genius? I’ll become an immortal for sure and won’t ruin your reputation.” He said. This was still understating his innate talent.

“No.” Till Ancestor refused.

“Brat, you can’t miss this chance, hurry. And Senior, since I brought you a nice disciple, shouldn’t I be rewarded?” He beckoned Li Qiye while not wanting to miss a potential reward from Till Ancestor.
